exact_claims.statement: There are actual full evaluation-kernel paths on unions of rational lines for which a singleton sampled prime always divides a full-path minor but never a deleted-path minor; the record changes on every such edge. Treating the removed prime as independent of the full-path minor is not a valid alternative proof.

source: Old Argus report.md:268-319 and actual-kernel finite regression; manuscript full-path definitions as assessed in actual-kernels.
assessment: The rational-line family gives genuine full evaluation kernels and permitted deterministic minors, with full singleton bad probability 1 and deleted bad probability 0. The record changes, so the correct deletion bound survives. The failure concerns an alternative independence principle, not the original manuscript.
supported_scope: Arbitrary fixed positive degree allowances with sufficiently many sampled rational lines.
Actual finite integer point sets and complete evaluation kernels, not invented adaptive minors.
Compatibility with the fixed box and uniform Hilbert alternatives.
A permitted deterministic primitive line equation and first nonzero Jacobian minor; not every possible patch convention.
Retirement of R_FULL_MINOR_INDEPENDENCE with its mathematical reason preserved.
unresolved_obligations: Native independent review of the construction and family coverage.
No extension from the singleton/empty-other-block example to a refutation of the final scheduled-block mechanism is asserted.

jacobian.mathematical_scope: Exact rank of the supplied 4-by-6 matrix over GF(7) only.
